sentences.text: South Australia’s Deputy Independent Commissioner Against Corruption evaluated practices at the City of Playford Council to identify improvements to integrity controls.
sentences.support:
My role is limited to evaluating processes 
in the context of protecting the integrity 
of a public institution

sentences.text: The evaluation focused on current administration practices, including policies, records, procurement and human resources.
sentences.support:
This report also addresses opportunities to improve integrity measures in respect of 
procurement and human resource management.

sentences.text: The Deputy Commissioner identified weaknesses in policy implementation, compliance and records management that exposed the council to integrity risks.
sentences.support:
those weaknesses primarily relate to the manner in which policies and 
procedures are implemented and adhered to

sentences.text: The Deputy Commissioner made 21 recommendations covering governance, records, recruitment, performance management and procurement.
sentences.support:
I have made 21 recommendations which I hope will be of assistance to the City 
of Playford

findings.quote:
However, there remain a number of weaknesses in current council operations that 
leave it susceptible to corruption, misconduct or maladministration.

notes: The evaluation assesses current systems and does not adjudicate historical allegations or service delivery performance.
